(__gts_fnArg) => __gts_fnArg.e.switchInfo.to.definition.id === Jahoda && [
                  Aura.Pyro,
                  Aura.Hydro,
                  Aura.Electro,
                  Aura.Cryo,
                  Aura.CryoDendro
                ].includes(__gts_fnArg.query($.opp.active.includesDefeated).aura)

(__gts_fnArg) => [
                        Reaction.ElectroCharged,
                        Reaction.LunarElectroCharged,
                        Reaction.Bloom,
                        Reaction.LunarBloom,
                        Reaction.CrystallizeHydro,
                        Reaction.LunarCrystallizeHydro
                      ].includes(__gts_fnArg.e.getReaction())
